output.title: Unpublish Exam

scope_summary.database: No schema changes. Active-session guard uses exam_sessions query. Portal filter on e.status='active' provides implicit assignment hold.
scope_summary.api: POST /api/v1/exams/{id}/unpublish — active→draft transition, blocked if in-progress sessions exist

key_decisions: Dedicated /unpublish endpoint (not reusing TransitionStatus) to allow explicit active-session guard
validTransitions map is NOT changed — unpublish is a guarded reverse transition, not a generic forward step
No DDL change for assignment hold — portal query WHERE e.status='active' provides behavior implicitly
Archived exams remain a terminal state — unpublish only applies to active exams
